homepage.name: Yehuda Shmulevitz
homepage.role: AI Engineer · Software Engineer · Backend & Cloud Developer
homepage.summary: Software Engineer focused on building production-oriented AI systems, RAG applications, AI agents, backend services, and cloud-native solutions. Experienced with OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, local LLMs, agentic workflows, model evaluation, and AWS-based architectures.
homepage.projectPayrollDesc: AI-powered payroll platform combining document extraction, RAG, agentic workflows, guardrails, deterministic validation, model evaluation, and RBAC.
homepage.projectPayrollTech: Stack: Python, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, Docker, OpenAI, Ollama, RAG, LangGraph.
homepage.projectAssistantDesc: AI-powered internal IT assistant using Amazon Bedrock, RAG, and AI agents, with serverless AWS infrastructure and usage analytics.
homepage.projectAssistantTech: Stack: Python, Flask, Amazon Bedrock, DynamoDB, Lambda, S3, Docker, RAG.
homepage.projectMesayaDesc: Cloud-based career platform with secure authentication, multiple user roles, AI-powered capabilities, and scalable AWS services.
homepage.projectMesayaTech: Stack: Node.js, Next.js, AWS Cognito, DynamoDB, S3, SES, Bedrock.
homepage.projectHeartDesc: Machine-learning pipeline that predicts heart-attack risk based on clinical features. Includes preprocessing, feature scaling, training and performance evaluation.
homepage.projectHeartTech: Tech Stack: Python, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib
homepage.projectWarehouseDesc: Web application for managing equipment lending in a warehouse, with real-time data updates and a modern frontend. This project won 1st place at Azrieli College.
homepage.projectWizardDesc: Third-person arena game with enemy AI, health system, difficulty levels and performance optimization via object pooling. Focused on gameplay design and systems thinking.
homepage.projectWizardTech: Tech Stack: Unity (C#), Physics, Object Pooling, AI
homepage.projectDiskDesc: File system simulation that emulates file operations on a virtual disk, showcasing low-level programming, file handling and system calls.
homepage.projectDiskTech: Tech Stack: C++, File Handling, System Calls
homepage.projectExtDesc: Chrome extension that injects UI controls into Google Search results, enabling users to hide or filter specific results using safe DOM manipulation and dynamic node detection.
homepage.projectExtTech: Tech Stack: JavaScript, DOM APIs, Manifest V3
homepage.educationDegreeDesc: Strong foundation in software engineering, computer science, system design, security, machine learning, and software development.
homepage.educationTrainingDesc: Advanced training focused on modern AI engineering and AI-assisted software development.
homepage.toolsText: Beyond my main projects, I build small tools and games to experiment with new ideas, architectures and UI patterns. These are presented as a playground and technical sandbox.
homepage.toolsNote: Mini apps are not production systems, but they reflect curiosity, quick experimentation and continuous learning.

JpgToPdf.title: JPG to PDF Converter
JpgToPdf.subtitle: Upload images, rotate or reorder them, click convert, then download the PDF.
JpgToPdf.dropHint: Supported: JPG / JPEG / PNG. You can select as many images as you want.
JpgToPdf.reorderHint: Reorder: drag a card and drop it onto another card. Rotate: use Rotate left on any image.
JpgToPdf.noImagesError: Please upload at least one image before converting.
JpgToPdf.invalidFileType: Only JPG / JPEG / PNG image files are supported.
JpgToPdf.convertFailed: Conversion failed. Please try again with different images.
JpgToPdf.howItWorksTitle: How does it work behind the scenes?
JpgToPdf.howItWorksP1: The entire conversion happens locally in your browser - no files are uploaded to an external server.
JpgToPdf.howItWorksP2: After you upload images, they are temporarily kept in memory and shown as previews. You can drag to reorder them, and the chosen order becomes the page order in the final PDF.
JpgToPdf.howItWorksP3: When you click "Convert", each image is processed individually: the tool reads the file, detects its original dimensions, and creates a matching PDF page with the correct size and orientation. Each image is then added as a new page.
JpgToPdf.howItWorksP4: Once finished, a complete PDF is generated and becomes available for instant download. Everything stays on your device - fast, private, and with no data sent out.

PdfMerge.title: Merge PDF Files
PdfMerge.subtitle: Upload multiple PDF files, reorder files and pages, rotate individual pages, then merge and download.
PdfMerge.dropHint: File order and page order define the final merged document.
PdfMerge.reorderHint: Reorder files: drag a file block and drop it onto another file block.
PdfMerge.reorderPagesHint: Reorder pages: drag a page card within the same file.
PdfMerge.emptyPages: One or more PDF files contain no pages.
PdfMerge.needAtLeastTwo: Please upload at least two PDF files to merge.
PdfMerge.maxFilesReached: You reached the maximum of {max} files.
PdfMerge.parseFailed: Failed to read one or more PDF files.
PdfMerge.mergeFailed: Merge failed. Please try again with different files.
PdfMerge.howItWorksTitle: How does it work behind the scenes?
PdfMerge.howItWorksP1: Everything happens locally in your browser — no files are uploaded to an external server.
PdfMerge.howItWorksP2: After uploading PDFs, each file is split into page cards. You can reorder files, reorder pages inside each file, and rotate any page before merging.
PdfMerge.howItWorksP3: When you click "Merge", each page is copied into a new document in your chosen order. Rotations are applied to the actual PDF output, not just the preview.
PdfMerge.howItWorksP4: Once finished, a single merged PDF is generated and becomes available for instant download. Everything stays on your device - fast, private, and with no data sent out.
